name: awesome-skills
description: Agent Skills by @kryptobaseddev, plus the plugins that wrap them. Skills install on their own by copy or symlink; a plugin is only needed where a skill cannot reach — slash commands, subagents, and hooks.

plugins.name: deluxui
plugins.description: UX engineering with a verdict. Adds /ux-init, /ux-create, /ux-improve, /ux-critique, /ux-audit, /ux-harden, /ux-responsive and /ux-optimize, an independent ux-reviewer subagent, and a PostToolUse hook that checks every interface file as it is written. Wraps the deluxui skill (190-rule contract, 163 detectors, release gate where NOT_RUN is never a pass).
